svg.title: PeriNest 巢穴意象 v2 · 玻璃透视的蜚蠊
svg.desc: A cockroach sealed in glass-amber, every body part layered with highlight and shadow for a volumetric read. Antennae sway, the heart pulses, the nerve cord fires, spiracles breathe, pheromone trails drift. Eleven organs map to eleven modules of the PeriNest 4-terminal system.
svg.text: Built to Survive, Designed to Adapt · since 300 Ma
